subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policies
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you about some recent updates to our company policies regarding remote work and communication protocols. These changes are aimed at improving efficiency and collaboration within our team. Please review the attached document for detailed information. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to HR. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
